ModMetaData.name: Jawa Restraining Bolts
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: DROID_FDE_GOODWILL_CAP_1. Caps the player's goodwill ceiling with the Free Droid Enclaves by how many currently-owned droids carry a restraining bolt right now (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/restraining_bolt_technical.md). One GoodwillSituationDef + one GoodwillSituationWorker, no Harmony, no stored state -- the count is read live off Droid Depot's OuterRim_RestraintBolt hediff every recache, so freeing a droid lifts the ceiling within the engine's own ~1000-tick recompute, no removal hook needed. Degrades quietly (returns the vanilla default) if Droid Depot is not active, or if the Free Droid Enclaves faction has not loaded.
